required_source_objects.description: Official docket entry and metadata for Dkt. 225
Original filed PDF associated with Dkt. 225
Notice of Electronic Filing or equivalent service/entry notice
Official current docket status and immediately surrounding entries necessary to interpret procedural posture

execution_phases.name: SOURCE_DISCOVERY
actions: Search approved official and source-native repositories using exact case number and docket number
Capture native object identifiers and source locations before downloading
Separate filed motion, proposed order, entered order, rejection notice, and NEF identities
execution_phases.exit_gate: Every required object is either located by official native ID or has a precise source-specific access blocker

execution_phases.name: BYTE_PRESERVATION
actions: Acquire original bytes without editing or conversion
Preserve original filename, size, timestamps, and metadata
Compute SHA-256 and store in approved evidence custody without overwrite
execution_phases.exit_gate: Every acquired object has verified bytes, hash, custody object ID, and readback

execution_phases.name: IDENTITY_AND_STATUS_VERIFICATION
actions: Verify case number, docket number, entry date, filer, title, page count, and procedural status
Compare docket metadata to acquired PDF and notice metadata
Record contradictions or missing fields without resolving by assumption
execution_phases.exit_gate: All identities are reconciled or explicitly flagged with evidence-grounded discrepancies

execution_phases.name: CROSS_SYSTEM_REGISTRATION

destinations.supabase: canonical acquisition ledger, hashes, state transitions, readback receipts
destinations.github: manifest and status only; no protected source bytes
destinations.box: original source bytes and provenance receipt
destinations.clickup_asana_linear: execution state and review gates only

execution_phases.exit_gate: Every destination write is retrieved and native IDs are recorded

execution_phases.name: COMPLETION_OR_PRECISE_BLOCKER
completion_test: Official filed PDF acquired and hash-verified, or exact source blocker recorded
NEF or equivalent acquired and hash-verified, or exact source blocker recorded
Official docket entry and surrounding status captured
All storage and control-plane writes retrieved

next_action: Search existing controlled evidence stores for the official Dkt. 225 docket entry, filed PDF, NEF, and surrounding status; do not infer missing contents.
